blocks.title: Photodegradable
blocks.text: Kuch functional groups dhoop se UV (ultraviolet) roshni ki shakal mein zyada energy absorb (jazb) kar sakte hain. Aise groups wale polymers roshni se toot sakte hain aur photodegradable kehlate hain.

Kuch aise polymers banaye gaye hain jin ki chains mein carbonyl groups (C=O) hain, kyun ke yeh roshni zyada jazb karte hain (photoabsorption). Absorb ki hui UV roshni chain ke andar ke bonds aur mukhtalif chains ke darmiyan forces ko kamzor karti hai. Is se polymer zyada biodegradable ho jata hai aur qudrati mahol mein kam zehreele compounds mein jaldi toot'ta hai. Lekin photodegradable plastics zyada arsa istemal nahi ho sakte, aur in ki recycling (dobara istemal ke qabil banana) achhi tarah nahi hoti. Saath hi plastic landfills mein dabaya jata hai jahan roshni nahi pohanchti, is liye wahan photodegradation nahi hoti.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab "photosortpion" chhapti hai. Sahi lafz photoabsorption (roshni absorb karna) hai.

Polyesters aur polyamides in halaat mein biodegrade ho sakte hain, is liye yeh kuch doosre plastics ki tarah hamesha mahol mein nahi rehte. Is se plastic pollution ke bure asraat kam hote hain. Scientists aur engineers is ilm se aise materials bana sakte hain jo zaroorat khatam hone par toot jayein. Maslan kuch medical implants (jism ke andar lagaye jane wale devices) aur ghul jane wale tanke (dissolvable stitches) aise polyesters se bante hain jo jism mein hydrolysis se dheere dheere toot jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Photodegradable plastics ka aik faida aur aik kami batayein.
blocks.explanation: Faida: in ke C=O groups UV roshni jazb karte hain, is liye yeh mahol mein jaldi toot'te hain. Kami: landfill mein roshni nahi pohanchti (ya: yeh zyada arsa istemal nahi ho sakte aur in ki recycling achhi nahi hoti).

items: Photodegradable: C=O groups UV jazb kar ke chain ke bonds aur chains ke darmiyan forces kamzor karte hain.
Limitations (kamiyan): kam arsa istemal, kamzor recycling, landfills mein roshni nahi.
Polyester ke ghul jane wale tanke jism mein hydrolysis se toot jate hain.
